title: Fadebot parameter-tuning rescue (stops/exits/entries/liquidity)
hypothesis: Retuning stop distance, exit targets/holds, entry pump thresholds or liquidity gates turns fadebot's negative expectancy positive.
falsifiable_prediction: At least one of 16 parameter variants produces positive closed-trade P&L on the 3-day replay extract with BH-FDR survival vs baseline.
kill_criteria: No variant positive, or no FDR survivor vs baseline.
kill_cause: Falsified on replay (2026-07-03/04/11, literal live code): all 16 variants negative; best per-trade -0.095 vs baseline -0.126; BH-FDR survivors 0/15. Stop widening 2->no-stop moves P&L only -1.26 -> -1.16. Problem is structural, not parametric.
regime_notes: GB/IE horse racing, T-90m..T-15m window, 5s replay cadence. Replay baseline matches live forensic (-0.126 vs -0.119/trade).

title: Fadebot structural flip: BACK the pump continuation
hypothesis: The pump-completion signal has positive expectancy when traded as a BACK (riding continuation) instead of a LAY (fading).
falsifiable_prediction: At least one of 9 flip variants produces positive closed-trade P&L on the in-sample replay window, with direction dominance over fade and OOS persistence on held-out days.
kill_criteria: No positive flip variant, no significant direction dominance, or best cell fails OOS.
kill_cause: All 9 flip variants negative in-sample (best F06_pump18 -0.041/trade). Direction dominance not significant (flip better 4/6 pairs, sign p=0.34, BH-FDR 0/6). Best cell failed OOS on held-out 2026-07-12/13/14 (-0.32, n=1). Flow-confirmation gate rejected all signals. Pump-completion trading is negative in BOTH directions across 25 variants and 6 replay days.
regime_notes: GB/IE racing T-90m..T-15m; replay 5s cadence; targets almost never hit in either direction (1 target exit across flip matrix).

title: Pre-off drift/steam/surge/imbalance signals (scout sweep 1)
hypothesis: Simple pre-off price/volume signals (drift, late steam, volume surge, book imbalance) predict mid-price direction in the T-30m..T-15m forward window.
falsifiable_prediction: At least one signal cell shows mean signed forward return significantly > 0 after BH-FDR (m=6) on the discovery window AND keeps a positive sign out-of-sample.
kill_criteria: No BH-FDR survivor, or sign instability between windows.
kill_cause: No BH-FDR survivor in either window (discovery m=6: none; OOS m=6: none). Signs flip between windows: drift>=5% -1.43% (discovery) vs +6.02% (OOS); steam>=6% +0.75% vs -0.54%. imbal_backheavy +2.9% both windows but p>=0.21. No persistent directional edge in these naive families.
regime_notes: GB/IE racing, T-90m..T-15m window (replay collector cutoff). 1541 + 946 runner series across 6 days. Scout collector now gathering to-the-off data for sharper versions.
